title: Copy the two measured BYH3 vendor RIL libraries to the host with read-only root (decision 0002 item 3)
acceptance: Before any read, the single selected endpoint reports SM-S921B, e1s and S921BXXS9BYH3; otherwise nothing is read.

Only /vendor/lib64/libsec-ril.so and /vendor/lib64/libsecril-client.so are read, through su with cat and sha256sum only; no write, chmod, mount, setenforce, setprop, service, modem or RIL command is issued and nothing is executed from the files.

Each copy's host SHA-256 equals the on-device sha256sum and its size equals the CELL-010 measurement (5459848 and 134368 bytes); the bytes stay in ignored artifacts and are never committed or published; only hashes, sizes and ELF header facts are recorded.
Evidence records the exact commands, exit codes and the device inventory, and states that root access is not proof of safety.
steps: Two read-only su reads with on-device hashes
